WELCOME TO MY TEMPLAR BOYSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSS

Build has Levelling, Early/Mid Game and End Game setup.

I'm updating this page as I make any Update/Change to the build, bookmark this!

EDIT 1: We only have 4 Stigmas available at the same time, setup fixed and added a swap to safe option for tough fights.
EDIT 2: Daevanion board updated (tip: Prioritize getting skills at lvl12 rather than completing the board or getting the corner keynodes)
EDIT 3: Added intermidiate build setups (Gear progression) all the way to 1800.
EDIT 4: Updated/Reworked Daevanion Board for Improved DPS Setup (Added Pummel to Macro combo).
EDIT 5: Added Daevanion Board progression for levelling!
EDIT 6: Added GIGATANKY Setup (Tank+Support) best suited for Endgame Dungeons (Video below)
EDIT 7: Swapped Executing blade for Noble Armor in the GIGATANKY Setup (Defense down in PvE doesn't work bruh)
EDIT 8: Added my current Setup!
EDIT 9: IMPROVED Build with Taunt (didn't know it grants damage tldr). new skills setup is online
EDIT 10: ADDED Speedfarming setup with infinite Doomshield+Judgment.
EDIT 11: ADDED complete Genus Insight.
EDIT 12: ADDED extra step to Daevanion board.

Check my YouTube for more, LIVESTREAMING EVERY SINGLE DAY ON YOUTUBE at least 8hrs: @xleonis

Full YouTube video guide explaining how the build works, showing the Macro, what to prioritize when it comes to Skill lvls, Stats on Gear and so on!

guides.name: Block Tank PvP/PvE - Includes Builds For Every Stage of The Game - Sulla / Astolfo / Magi Ranni — riderastolfo

$join.$t: Билд с Questlog: №{rank} по популярности у класса, автор {author}. Стадий: {stages} — выберите целевую.

$join:
NOTES:
Firstly, this is a work in progress. It will be updated as I play and refine the build.

Second, I will not be copying builds. This will be my own "cooking" designed mainly for PVP, this is because high end PVP will require optimized builds much more then PVE content clearing. The best choice is to eventually have one for each.

The best example of this will be skills, honestly over geared is over geared for both PVP and PVE. However, that advantage won't last forever.

No I don't own every skin and pet in the game, nor do you. What you see is the worst case scenario not best case that no one has yet.

Prioritize Space, Destiny, and Life when you can.

Will add arcana later, but really that can be based on what your gear looks like.

PVP SKILLS ARE [Under Construction - WIP] - (There are some TIPS in the description of the PvP skill page).
Skill pages in general might need a bit a clarity work so [WIP] - Currently I couldn't decide if I wanted to use the priority tab for leveling prio or casting prio

I am testing the builds extensively currently in the highest end parts of the game.
I may consider getting dex on gear but realistically its kinda troll but ill mess with a private QL build to see if there are any setups to leverage DEX (which gives block).

There is a build for every tier of the games content, all are complete except the end-game PvP / PvE W/Stat Prio Builds.

Blue gear is interchangeable as long as the base gear score is somewhat is near the gear shown.

Updates and FAQ:

Why i shouldn't go for resplended dragon? they are BiS.
Answer: right now every whale is trying to get their hands on those items, so what can we do to make a profit out of it? Sell every blue artisan orb that sells for more than 500k (or just gamba to sell the iem).
If you are going for the resplended dragon pieces you need to keep in mind that every piece you get needs the same (artisan) piece 2 more times in order to get an item with itemlevel higher than ludra.

Regarding items:
what works for me is the following:
you drop a golden chest piece. you check the endgame build, and you see that the piece you dropped has no good stats for you.
you then ask yourself, is this the last time that i am going to drop a chest of this rarity?
if for example you dropped a vakron chest piece, you are going to change it for Nuakum, so you just use that terrible chest, and hope for a better Nuakum drop down the line.
what you do on this scenario is getting it to +10 and use it till your next drop.
